A.name: Mayor Jared Gray
A.basis: Presides throughout: calls the meeting to order, excuses Wood and Huish, reads the property-tax impact schedule, and runs the position-by-position budget consensus.

B.name: Ben (City Manager)
B.basis: City-manager framing ('when I first started as a city manager here in Eagle Mountain'), the Norm Dugger budget quote, and the walkthrough of the personnel list and Community Services Director role. (One stray adjournment 'yes' tagged to Whiting bled onto this label at the very end.)

C.name: Kimberly (Finance / Admin Services)
C.basis: Budget lead: explains the truth-in-taxation requirement, the October-to-P1/P2 budget process, and general-fund vs. RAP-tax funding; addressed as Kimberly and confirms outside-counsel spend and the June 16 deadline.

D.name: Melissa Yates (Purchasing)
D.basis: The tearful purchasing-agent testimony — 'every purchase over $75,000 comes through me... my name's on all of them,' 10 RFPs since March; Wright addresses her as 'Melissa.'

E.name: Zach Hilton (Parks / Public Works staff)
E.basis: The public-works voice the mayor introduces as 'Hilton, not councilman'; details the mill-and-overlay tailings, road base, and dust control for the Lone Tree access, and is addressed as 'Zach' by Wright.

F.name: Councilmember Melissa Clark
F.basis: Kimberly confirms 'Councilmember Clark, you asked for succinct'; the 'nerds' endearment, the 'don't answer it like a lawyer' justice-court exchange, the Lone Tree cautionary-tale speech, and the recorded adjournment 'yes.'

H.name: Councilmember Craig Whiting
H.basis: Seconds the motion to adjourn (mayor names 'Council Member Whiting'); the agricultural-zoning line-in-the-sand west of Lone Tree, the Lehi speed-bump anecdote, and pressing for outside-counsel data.

I.name: Brad (Parks / Public Works)
I.basis: Mayor says 'Brad, you got something to say, so step up to the plate'; explains the community-forester/arborist crew structure and years of Lone Tree landowner/easement meetings.

J.name: Councilmember Zac Huish
J.basis: The remote member with recurring audio failures who apologizes for not attending in person; questions 'Kim' on the P1/P2 totals, warns against RAP-tax salaries, and pitches Anthropic/Claude licenses.

L.name: David Salazar (City Engineer)
L.basis: Wright says 'come tell us, David, what is it going to cost'; prices the ~$5M, ~5,100-ft Lone Tree collector road across JDH/Perry and the concrete vs. asphalt speed-table costs.

M.name: Marcus (City Attorney)
M.basis: Addressed as 'Marcus'; explains outside-counsel litigation costs, missed DRC attendance, the Comcast franchise backlog, and concedes the city is 'legally entitled' to a justice court.
